0.content:
Navia met Clorinde as a girl of a little over ten through Clorinde's mentor, the Marechaussee Hunter Petronilla, a friend of Callas. They played tabletop games together, Clorinde hosting and Navia's wild choices keeping her on her toes. When Callas was framed, he chose a duel against Clorinde, asked her to look after his daughter, and refused to yield. For three years Navia could not forgive her, though they never fully broke off; Clorinde shadowed her to keep her promise. Once the truth came out in 4.0, they reconciled.

Navia says Clorinde does not say much but feels deeply, and that she never liked her "walking on eggshells". Now Navia invites her to Tabletop Troupe almost every other day. Clorinde, a senior game master there, is strict about the rules and cannot be bribed with snacks; she prefers not to play court characters so the mood stays light. Clorinde calls Navia's battle optimism "admirable", which Navia takes as praise.

In Clorinde's story quest (4.7), Navia recruited the Traveler and Furina to playtest "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day", in which Navia played a Marechaussee Hunter. Something real went wrong mid-game; Clorinde covered so smoothly that Furina thought it was planned, but Navia noticed and pressed her about it afterward. Clorinde's mail on her 2026 birthday says Navia rejected a curtains-and-ice-blocks mock-up of a frozen scenario and gave her train tickets to Snezhnaya instead.

1.content:
Callas Caspar, tall and blond with an anchor-marked eyepatch, founded the Spina di Rosula and sponsored Fontaine's aquabus system; the Callas Line bears his name. He refused the honorary title Palais Mermonia offered. He raised Navia as his successor in business, negotiation and weapons, but never spoke of his feelings or of her mother's death. Three years before the Fontaine Archon Quest, the Sinthe ring framed him for killing his informant Jacques; he died in a duel with Clorinde. Navia later learned he chose death so the ring would not touch her, since his associates would have released their evidence if she were harmed.

After his arrest most supporters abandoned him and people called him "Callas the Unfaithful". In 4.0 Navia exposed Marcel in court, cleared her father publicly and held his long-delayed memorial. She has vowed to be "the president for the Spina of today", not a copy of him, though Spina veterans and Furina see the resemblance growing.

Character Story 4 sets out her theories about him: he hid his pain to spare her guilt, and refused the title so the Spina would stay close to ordinary people. She never asked him, thinking there would be time. He once played a reluctant, low-voiced game master at her birthday party, and he found her Vision in the dice box.

2.content:
Melus, the steady, older attendant, and Silver, a nervous rookie, became Navia's bodyguards after Callas's death and followed her everywhere. When Primordial Seawater surged into lower Poisson in 4.2, both were dissolved while rescuing people. They had asked to be buried beside Callas, a wish she could not grant.

When Navia fell into Primordial Seawater in ancient ruins, she woke in a dream of the Opera Epiclese, surrounded by jealous victims urging her to stay. Melus and Silver warned her not to admit guilt, and Neuvillette led her out. He later told her two Oceanids had caught her for a split second so he could save her. She wept at their loyalty after death.

Melus decorated her home, and she keeps it as it is. Since he died she organises her own memos, learning fast. At her coming-of-age party Melus played a clumsy commissioner and Silver, dragged in while passing, a mighty mage.

3.content:
A citizen-oriented Fontainian society funded by supporters and business ventures. It works mainly with the people of Poisson and Fleuve Cendre, solves problems the Gardes won't or can't, and cooperates with the authorities when needed. Navia sums it up as a business partner that helps with any problem, "using the velvet glove or the iron fist as appropriate". Its heart-shaped rose logo was designed by Clementine. Members call Navia "Boss".

For trouble she points people to Mr. Tetreaux at the bar; for people who won't talk, the enforcer Sonny, "White Glove". Senior adviser Florent took over Melus's duties. The Spina organised the rescue during the Poisson flood and staffed the crowd at Furina's trial. It has a supply agreement with the Fortress of Meropide, and Chiori designs its formal wear.

A Tent Tortoise named Consigliere, an old friend of Callas, lives among them. In the limited 4.8 event Summertide Scales and Tales, Navia founded a Simulanka branch and appointed Bizerte its head.

4.comment: Navia: The Sinthe case and Marcel
4.content:
Sinthe was a popular Poisson drink secretly made from diluted Primordial Seawater, ruinous over time. Marcel, head of the Confrerie of Cabriere (supposedly a sister group to the Spina), ran the trade and was secretly Vacher, a Snezhnayan adventurer who had abducted young women for twenty years trying to revive his dissolved lover Vigneire. After Navia stirred up the disappearance case, he spiked her Fonta with Primordial Seawater; Paimon drank it instead, unharmed because she is not Fontainian. Navia and the Traveler traced the case to him, and she exposed him in court.

In 4.0 Navia stalled the court while Tartaglia stood accused of the disappearances. With Clorinde's testimony and evidence the Traveler took from Marcel's hideout, she cleared both Tartaglia and her father. Before his exposure Marcel played the kindly elder, telling her there was no shame in backing out.

5.comment: Navia: The Poisson flood and the Fatui
5.content:
In 4.2 a tremor released Primordial Seawater into lower Poisson; those it touched dissolved. The Spina treated the wounded and evacuated survivors. Arlecchino's House of the Hearth, exploring nearby ruins, joined the relief, counting heads and measuring water levels. Navia accepted gratefully but told the Traveler she would never leave herself vulnerable to the Fatui.

After more dealings she decided Arlecchino was less terrifying than she seemed, and told the anxious Escoffier so. Her settled view: a formidable, caring leader who is still a Harbinger, which means a ruthless side. She remembers Lyney putting on a free magic show for Poisson's children during the flood.

6.content:
Navia barely knew her mother, who died of complications after her birth; Callas hid the cause for years. When Navia was grown he gave her Clementine's notebook of hopes for her unborn child, from good virtues to adventures and fine food. It ends by calling them "just my own wishes". Navia was angry at the delay, then understood: her mother did not want those hopes to become a burden, so they waited until she had chosen her own path.

People say Navia is like her mother, but she does not mean to become her either. Clementine supported Callas's aquabus plan, and the Clementine Line is named for her; Navia feared losing that link when Romeuf's men tried to bomb it. Clementine also designed the Spina's logo.

7.comment: Navia: Braving the Tides Together (Romeuf and Colter)
7.content:
Navia's story quest. Rebuilding Poisson without Melus and Silver, she met Colter, an old member just released from the Fortress of Meropide, who warned her of Romeuf's faction. They had left on bad terms over the aquabus funding and hated the whole Caspar family. Romeuf's men planned to bomb the Clementine Line so rubble would bury Poisson, while Colter, blaming Navia for Melus's death, tried to kill her. Florent blocked the blow, she subdued Colter, and her Geo held back the falling rubble.

She refused to deal privately with Romeuf's people because they had endangered innocents, and let the Maison Gardiennage prosecute them. She told Colter she was not Callas and would listen. She dismissed him but promised he could return to Poisson after his sentence. The residents then showed her the design for a statue of her standing with her parents. Earlier she let a group of Romeuf's men go with a warning, and caught no fish because she forgot the hook.

8.comment: Navia: The umbrella-gun and the Vision
8.content:
Navia combined a gun with an umbrella so she would not have to carry too much: Fontaine alternates rain and hard sun, and the Demoiselle of the Spina must be armed. She received her Geo Vision at her coming-of-age birthday party, during a tabletop game. Her adventurer won by ordering the doctor to "Shoot me instead!", Callas found the jewel in the dice box, and her first Geo blade split the cake and the table.

Lying awake that night, she could not remember what she had wished for: the hard-won victory, or birthdays always full of friends. She decided it must be the second. She thinks using elements without a Vision, as the Traveler does, is far cooler than having one.

9.content:
When Neuvillette offered condolences over her father's duel, Navia lashed out, then apologised. He saved her from the Primordial Sea in 4.2. He says he still feels guilt over Callas and a distance from her he cannot easily close. She likens him to rocky reefs in the sea: hard to navigate until you learn the signs. As a child she saw Furina in a charity opera and felt she was more herself on stage than as Archon, an intuition she now thinks was right. Navia's agents and diluted seawater helped expose Furina at the 4.2 trial.

Furina admires Navia's macarons and calls her a strong person who acts as if everything is fine to spare others, more and more like her father. In the limited 4.4 Lantern Rite, Navia and Clorinde escorted Furina to Qiaoying Village, where Navia, copying Furina, shouted from a mountaintop.

10.content:
A Fontainian club that publishes roleplaying scripts. Navia has loved it since childhood and she and Clorinde are veteran members. She likes bold, luck-driven play ("authentic mode"), often uses her real name for characters, and tries to bend the rules or bribe the game master. In 4.7 she recruited the Traveler and Furina to playtest a new script for the club.

Lynette and Freminet turned down that playtest, and she had given the Spina a few days off. Her table persona is "monster hunter by trade and helpful neighbourhood businesswoman on the side." Clorinde remembers the position of every token, so there is no cheating.

11.content:
Escoffier met Navia at Hotel Debord on Escoffier's own fifth birthday by returning Navia's rose-scented hat; they share afternoon teas, though Escoffier thinks Navia likes her desserts far too sweet. Navia wants to take her on picnics with sunglasses and a parasol. Chiori makes the Spina's formal wear and calls Navia's ideas more outlandish than her own; she vetoed a ten-metre top-hat shop sign. Charlotte counts Navia among her favourite subjects (a photo of her titled "The Soaring Yellow Rose" hangs at The Steambird) and quietly does damage control on bad news about her.

In Chiori's story quest (4.5) Navia's people escorted the courier Kirara when a rival harassed her. Seeing Chiori's wrecked stock, Navia assumed vandals and demanded names, then apologised and lent Spina hands for sewing. In Escoffier's story quest (5.6) she waited outside Hotel Debord over a kitchen dispute and brought the Traveler in; afterward she lamented that an antique jar found in the ruins had been shattered.

12.comment: Navia: Nod-Krai: the Nasha Town expo
12.content: During the limited 6.5 event Where Waves Meet the Reef, Navia ran a booth at Nasha Town's trade expo selling Fontaine Research Institute devices that use both Arkhe energies. It was cover: Fontaine had learned an international smuggling syndicate was interested, and she was there to hide Chevreuse's presence, with Clorinde along for protection. Jahoda, having heard of both women's reputations, placed her booth as far from Beidou's as possible. Navia failed to sell a weapon to a syndicate spy (Clorinde reminded her this was not Tabletop Troupe), and the Spina, with local help, caught several agents. She explained Fontaine's justice to the local children Neb, Raya and Ati. A Travelers' Tales anecdote added in 6.4 (permanent) also shows her and Clorinde in Nasha Town, running a Tabletop Troupe game with Illuga and Jahoda, Navia playing a Marechaussee Hunter.

13.content: Clorinde's birthday letter (2026-09-20) says the Tabletop Troupe released a scenario set in a land of extreme cold and Navia insisted on playing it on location. In a 7.1 anecdote the two are at Podvorye Restaurant in Snezhnograd with Vodyanitsa, a Snezhnayan fae who plays a bard, and Tighnari, a visiting scholar standing in for absent players Odette and Alyosha. Navia tries to blow open an ice wall with explosives "tucked away in my parasol", launching "umbrella warfare" just like in real life, and Clorinde rules that she has neither a parasol nor explosives in-game. In one branch Navia offers to hold up the collapsing wall though the check is nearly impossible ("I have to try!"), and calls Vodyanitsa a great person to play with. She is a tourist here, with no part in the Snezhnaya Archon Quest.

14.content:
- Lantern Rite (4.4): with Clorinde and Furina at Qiaoying Village, shouting from a mountaintop.
- Summertide Scales and Tales (4.8): in the storybook world of Simulanka she became "King" of Constellation Metropole ("Your Majesty" to its residents), in crown and fake moustache, and founded a local Spina branch under Bizerte.
- Whirling Waltz (5.6): co-created the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland amusement park with Lepine-Pauline, roped Escoffier into the food, coached the Traveler on the park's finances, greeted the Dragonlord Ajaw with a courtesy he appreciated even though she took him for Kinich's pet, and helped catch the smuggler Angoulvant.

15.content: The Traveler first met Navia at the twins' 4.0 trial for the disappearance of a spectator. Noticing some of her macarons had vanished during a lockdown, she reasoned the missing woman was hiding nearby and was not Fontainian, and had Lyney repeat the trick to produce her in court. She thinks Lyney is sincere and mature for his age and wants to invite the twins for macarons. Lyney credits her for their acquittal; Lynette says Navia acts like the nosy big sister next door and wishes the House had one like her.

16.content: The Spina and the Fortress of Meropide share a supply and logistics agreement from Callas's time. Navia finds Wriothesley exhausting to negotiate with; Clorinde tells her to collaborate within the agreement but not to believe everything he says. Wriothesley says he holds Navia in high regard and keeps their distance only to honour his agreement with Callas.

17.comment: Navia: Consigliere and Navia's small joys
17.content: Consigliere, a Tent Tortoise and old friend of Callas, was Navia's patient listener until Charlotte photographed her chatting to it and the tortoise became a public attraction; she says others deserve a turn. Her nanny Bracari helped teach her to shoot. Her childhood dog Shelly, named by her papa just after a seaside trip, guided her through abandoned pipes and died of illness; Navia still dreams of her. At the Fontaine Beauty Association, Sigewinne loves that Navia accepts compliments happily and takes souvenir photos. Navia's pleasures: baking and gingerbread contests, ice-cream races, odd new dishes, tea with milk, the Pluie Lotus. Her dislikes: thunder, rain, stale leftovers and cleaning up flour.
